Light Mode
Dark Mode

⚙️ Settings — Weekly Target

New "Consistency" section lets users set their weekly log target (3–7 days)

Settings Sheet
What changed visually:
  • Weekly Ring — 60pt circular progress ring below the status line. Shows "0/5" (or "2/5", "5/5") in the center. Sage green fill animates as you log. Checkmark when complete. Subtle glow at 80%+.
  • Streak Counter — "🔥 12-week streak" (or "Log this week" when streak is 0) sits to the right of the ring. Shows the target underneath.
  • Freeze Indicator — "❄️" badge on the ring + "2 freezes" text below when freezes are available. Turns gold when a freeze is protecting the week.
  • Settings — New "Consistency" section with a Stepper: "Log target: 5 days/week" (adjustable 3–7).
